headline: Red readiness this morning — you already banked a hard Un1t class into it, so the job now is protecting sleep and keeping tomorrow's long run genuinely easy.
body_state: HRV 37ms sits below your normal band and 14-day sleep debt is at 25h (last night 6.1h). Body Battery 38, training readiness 46/100 (Garmin) / 38.1 composite — today's verdict is **red, driver sleep**: "postpone quality, easy running only." TSB is -14, still inside the productive -5…-30 band, so overall training stress isn't blown out — but this is a recovery day, not a green light for more work.
session: This morning's Un1t class is already done — 42 min, avg HR 135, but ~69% of it sat in Z3-Z4 (29 of 42 min), landing real hard-intensity load on exactly the kind of day the readiness call was meant to protect. Nothing to undo now: treat the rest of today as recovery — no more structured effort, and get to bed ~60 min earlier to start paying down the debt. Tomorrow's 13km Long Run is unstructured on purpose (4:50-5:19/km, "run to feel") — keep it there. Your last two easy-labeled efforts both drifted faster than prescribed late on, so cap tomorrow by pace, not feel.
recent: A repeating pattern this block: Aug 12's tempo was cut short and ran 6-20s/km slower than the threshold band, HR never reaching LT despite RPE 8 — fatigue, not fitness. Aug 13's Un1t landed 52% in zone 3. Aug 14's "easy" run negative-split into RPE 6 and HR 166 in the closing minutes, well past conversational. Cadence has sat at 154-161 spm across all of them, still short of the 168-172 target set Aug 10. The through-line is grey-zone training — intensity keeps creeping into days meant to be easy, which is exactly what today's #1 limiter ("Recovery first") and the distribution flag (19.7% easy vs an 80% target) are calling out.
focus: No more intensity today — sleep is the lever, not training.
Tomorrow's long run: hold 4:50-5:19/km wire-to-wire, don't let a good feeling speed you up late.
Cadence still 154-161 spm vs the 168-172 target — cue it on the next quality session.
